ops.sql: SELECT o.Object_ID, o.Object_Type FROM t_object o INNER JOIN t_package p ON o.Package_ID = p.Package_ID WHERE p.Name IN ('_FIX-TEST') AND (o.Name IS NULL OR o.Name = '')
SELECT Object_ID, Name FROM t_object WHERE Package_ID = 1153 AND Name IS NULL
SELECT Object_ID, LENGTH(Name) AS ln FROM t_object WHERE Package_ID = 1153
